'''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-jedilevitation-2022-12-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-jedilevitation-2022-07-31.png]], 31 July 2022) → [[File:V0-L-jedilevitation-2022-12-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-jedilevitation.gif]], 12 December 2022). * '''Original''' ([[Jedi Levitation (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-jedilevitation022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.”
